release_notes:
SGB Browser v2.0.47 Official Complete Public Release:
• Universal Small-Screen & High-DPI Zero-Overlap UI Polish:
  - Redesigned the Global Premium VPN Studio Control Bar into 2 clean, compact, zero-overlap rows with adaptive screen-clamped geometry (eliminating clipped labels/buttons on 1280×720, 1366×768, and 125%–150% DPI laptops).
  - Compacted spacing, font sizes, and responsive control widths across Bot #7 Toolbars and Insights Hub PP Checker so every button, dropdown, and IP badge remains crisp and unclipped on any screen size.
• Enhanced LocalProxyBridge Upstream Error Diagnostics & Strict Proxy-Lock Pool:
  - `LocalProxyBridge` now preserves the exact upstream VPN/Proxy failure cause (429 Rate Limited, 407 Auth Failed, 503 Unavailable, Handshake Timeout) instead of masking all connection drops behind generic 502 Bad Gateway.
  - `FacebookTokenPool` supports strict proxy locking (`allow_direct_fallback=False`) to eliminate unintended direct-IP fallback leaks when VPN tunnels are active.
• 100% Dynamic NordVPN Zero-Leak Bridge + Auto IP Rotation & Strict Multi-VPN Provider Isolation:
  - Auto-upgrades logged-in Official NordVPN Extension into Zero-Leak TLS Bridge (`ext_tunnel`, Port 89 / SOCKS5 1080) with dynamic live re-login verification (zero hardcoding).
  - 3-Layer Dynamic Official NordVPN API (150+ live countries & 60+ live rotating `proxy_ssl` servers per country with Strict Country Lock & 10m live auto-refresh).
  - 100% Strict Provider Isolation across Surfshark <-> NordVPN <-> PIA <-> Windscribe <-> Custom (zero cross-provider credentials, host, port, or bridge leaks).
• Permanent 5x+ Ultra-Smooth Desktop Architecture (Built for 500–10,000+ Profiles, 100% Frozen-Safe):
  - Zero-overhead targeted QDialog/QWidget crash guards, Qt6 Smoothness & Idle-CPU Governor, O(1) Signature Caches & Hash-Indexed ProfileManager lookup, RAM-Resident GUI, Coalesced 65ms Log Batching, & Non-Blocking SQLite Scan.
  - Unified Pagination & Lazy Sub-Tabs Across Insights Hub (PP Checker, Page Insights, Page Details): Default 20/page with 20/30/50/100/All dropdowns + full-filtered Copy UIDs / Export CSV / Select All.
  - Profile Manager Safe 20/page Default Pagination with 50/100/200/All/page restored on demand & fixed UID containing '999' badge bug.
• Manual-Only Smart Cloud Sync (Google Drive & pCloud) + Hardened Meta View ⚡ Scan Stage-2 Selfie guard.
• Includes all v2.0.46 crash fixes, Instant Expired/Wrong OTP Exit (40+ languages), Strict 2FA & Disabled Profile Block, 5-Point Universal Dynamic VPN Re-Login, 9-Mode Anti-Detect Engine, and 50-Thread Filter.
